# Issue #010: Multi-Site Navigation Testing

## Description
Implement advanced navigation testing that visits multiple sites in sequence, capturing screenshots and page data at each step.

## Requirements
- Create a test script that navigates between at least 3 different websites
- Capture screenshots at each navigation step
- Extract and verify page titles
- Verify navigation success with appropriate assertions
- Handle page loading timeouts gracefully
- Test back/forward navigation capabilities

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] Test script successfully navigates between all sites
- [ ] Screenshots are captured for each site
- [ ] Page titles are correctly extracted and verified
- [ ] Error handling for navigation failures is implemented
- [ ] Test results are clearly reported

## Technical Implementation
Create a new test script (`test-multi-navigation.js`) that extends the existing browser testing features to handle sequential navigation across multiple sites.

## Related Components
- src/puppeteer.ts (navigate function)
- src/browser-manager.ts
- tests/test-browser.js (extend this approach)
